title: Gateway settings
description: The list of communication gateways known to CODESYS 4. A gateway relays the connection between the engineering tool and a plc.

gateways.title: Gateways
gateways.description: The configured gateways to choose from when going online with a plc.

type.title: Type
type.description: The gateway driver identifier. "CODESYS.GwV3" is the built-in CODESYS 3 gateway.

name.title: Name
name.description: A user-defined display name for this gateway.

hostName.title: Host name
hostName.description: IP address or host name where the gateway runs. Currently only IPv4 is fully supported.

port.title: Port
port.description: TCP port the gateway listens on.
